definition.solution: Disable the vulnerable endpoint at /etc/apache2/ until the patch is applied. Implement WAF rules to block exploitation attempts.

definition.description: CVE-2019-30289: SNMP default community strings detected on CentOS 7. Device exposes MIB tree at /etc/mysql/ without requiring authentication, permitting an attacker to bypass authentication controls via a crafted HTTP request. Service: Net-SNMP 3.4.5; port 161/UDP.
definition.solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to version 4.0.0 or later. Apply vendor security advisory and restart dependent services.

definition.description: CVE-2020-51831: Lighttpd on Debian 10 (Buster) offers ANON cipher suites. An attacker can read sensitive memory contents by exploiting a use-after-free condition. Listening on port 8080/TCP.
definition.solution: Apply HTML entity encoding to user inputs before rendering in templates. Use 'htmlspecialchars()' or equivalent in the application at /etc/mysql/.

definition.description: The SNMP agent running on Windows Server 2022 (version 8.0.3) exposes management data without authentication (CVE-2019-10053). SNMPv1/v2c community strings are transmitted in cleartext, enabling a network attacker to perform man-in-the-middle attacks. Affected service: Cisco IOS SNMP on port 161/UDP.
definition.solution: Update OpenSSL to the latest stable release (4.0.0). Verify linked libraries with 'openssl version -a'.

definition.description: CVE-2023-89408: Unpatched wget 2.1.4 on Fedora 36. Multiple known CVEs affect this version. An attacker can forge authentication tokens by abusing a misconfigured SNMP community string. Port: 22/TCP; installed at /usr/lib/ssl/.
definition.solution: Disable the vulnerable endpoint at /etc/apache2/ until the patch is applied. Implement WAF rules to block exploitation attempts.

definition.description: GnuTLS version 2.0.0 on Debian 11 (Bullseye) is affected by CVE-2022-84264. The library implements deprecated TLS 1.0 ciphersuites, allowing an attacker to crash the service and trigger a denial of service via a heap buffer overflow in the DNS response handler. Affected path: /etc/nginx/. Port: 636/TCP.
definition.solution: Use Windows Update / WSUS to apply KB5026361 and restart the system. Additionally, verify patch 26.

definition.description: CVE-2020-16400: PowerDNS on Fedora 36 is vulnerable to cache poisoning (version 6.0.0). An attacker can bypass authentication controls via SQL metacharacter injection in the login form. Config at /var/lib/mysql/; port 53/UDP.
definition.solution: Disable the vulnerable endpoint at /etc/apache2/ until the patch is applied. Implement WAF rules to block exploitation attempts.

definition.description: CVE-2022-45058: GnuTLS 2.3.1 on Debian 11 (Bullseye) ships with a vulnerable TLS stack. An attacker through a specially crafted packet could execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges. Binaries located at /etc/mysql/. Listening on port 993/TCP.
definition.solution: Generate a new CSR and obtain a renewed certificate from s Encrypt. Update the certificate at /etc/nginx/.

definition.description: CVE-2023-96954: Unpatched bash 3.0.0 on Windows Server 2019. Multiple known CVEs affect this version. An attacker can inject malicious payloads into database queries via a crafted HTTP request. Port: 22/TCP; installed at /etc/mysql/.

definition.description: CVE-2022-43361: Time-based SQLi in Tomcat on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. Unsanitized ORDER BY clause allows an attacker to read sensitive memory contents through a specially crafted packet. Affected app: /etc/mysql/; port 3306/TCP.
definition.solution: Configure Content-Security-Policy in /var/www/html/ to restrict script sources. Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

definition.description: CVE-2022-39536: Template injection leading to RCE in IIS 5.0.1 on Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. Server-side template expressions are evaluated from user input at C:\inetpub\wwwroot\, enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges by sending a malformed TLS ClientHello. Port: 8080/TCP.
definition.solution: Run 'pip install --upgrade zlib' or 'npm audit fix' to update vulnerable dependencies at /etc/openssl/.

definition.description: MbedTLS version 8.0.3 on Windows Server 2016 is affected by CVE-2022-56112. The library implements deprecated TLS 1.1 ciphersuites, allowing an attacker to perform man-in-the-middle attacks through improper bounds checking. Affected path: /var/lib/mysql/. Port: 8443/TCP.
definition.solution: Use Windows Update / WSUS to apply KB5027215 and restart the system. Additionally, verify patch 50.

definition.description: CVE-2021-52194: Missing Content-Security-Policy header on Nginx 3.1.2 (Ubuntu 18.04 LTS). Without CSP, an attacker can crash the service and trigger a denial of service through improper bounds checking. Web root: /var/log/; port 8080/TCP.

definition.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in FreeBSD kernel (version 8.0.3) on Windows Server 2016 — CVE-2021-82559. The vulnerability exists in the memcpy call at /home/user/.ssh/, enabling an attacker to bypass authentication controls.
definition.solution: Add firewall rules to restrict access to port 22 to authorized management networks only. Additionally, verify patch 34.
